subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 6: Finding Equations from Center and Radius
description: Write circle equations in center-radius form when the center and radius are given directly.
learningObjectives: Identify the center and radius from direct information
Write a circle equation in the form (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2
Use the correct signs for h and k in center-radius form
Square the radius correctly before writing the final equation
Check whether a point belongs to a circle by substituting its coordinates
prerequisites: Plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane
Squaring whole numbers and simple radicals
Recognizing the center-radius form of a circle
